questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {解答：设} f(x) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (2n+1) \frac{x^{n-1}}{3^{n}} = \frac{1}{x} \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (2n+1) \frac{(\sqrt{x})^{2n}}{3^{n}} = \frac{1}{x} g(\sqrt{x}) \ , \\ g(t) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (2n+1) \frac{t^{2n}}{3^{n}} = \left(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{t^{2n-1}}{3^{n}}\right)^{\prime} = \left(\frac{t^{3}}{3-t^{2}}\right)^{\prime} = \frac{9t^{2}-t^{4}}{(3-t^{2})^{2}} \ , \qquad \left(\frac{t^{2}}{3} < 1\right) \ , \\ \text {所以} f(x) = \frac{9-x}{(3-x)^{2}} \ . \end{array}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答：设}s(x)=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}(n+1)^{2}x^{n}\ ,\ \text{逐项积分}\omega\\&\int_{0}^{x}s(x)dx=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\int_{0}^{x}(n+1)^{2}x^{n}dx=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}(n+1)x^{n-1}=x\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}(n+1)x^{n}=xs_{1}(x)\ ,\\&\int_{0}^{x}s_{1}(x)dx=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\int_{0}^{x}(n+1)x^{n}dx=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}x^{n-1}=\frac{x}{1-x}(|x|<1)\ ,\\&\text{求导}s_{1}(x)=\left(\frac{x}{1-x}\right)^{\prime}=\frac{1}{(1-x)^{2}}\ ,\ \text{则}\int_{0}^{x}s(x)dx=\frac{x}{(1-x)^{2}}\ ,\ \omega\\&\text{再求导}\ s(x)=\left[\frac{x}{(1-x)^{2}}\right]^{\prime}=\frac{1+x}{(1-x)^{3}}(|x|<1)\ ,\ \omega\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} & \text{解答：} \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^{n}(n^{2}-n+1)}{2^{n}} = \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^{n}(n^{2}-n)}{2^{n}} + \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^{n}}{2^{n}} \ , \ \omega \\ & \quad = \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^{n}n(n-1)}{2^{n}} + \frac{1}{1-(-\frac{1}{2})} = \frac{1}{4} \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} n(n-1)\left(-\frac{1}{2}\right)^{n-2} + \frac{2}{3} \omega \\ & \text{设 } s(x) = \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} n(n-1)x^{n-2} \ , \ \text{逐项积分} \omega \\ & \quad \int_{0}^{x} s(x)dx = \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \int_{0}^{x} n(n-1)x^{n-2}dx = \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} nx^{n-1} \ , \ \omega \\ & \quad \text{再积分} \quad \int_{0}^{x} \left[ \int_{0}^{x} s(x)dx \right] dx = \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \int_{0}^{x} nx^{n-1}dx = \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} x^{n} = \frac{x^{2}}{1-x} \left( |x|<1 \right) \omega \\ & \quad \text{求导 } \int_{0}^{x} s(x)dx = \left( \frac{x^{2}}{1-x} \right)^{\prime} = \frac{2x-x^{2}}{(1-x)^{2}} \omega \\ & \quad \text{再求导 } s(x) = \left( \frac{2x-x^{2}}{(1-x)^{2}} \right)^{\prime} = \frac{2}{(1-x)^{3}} \ , \ s(-\frac{1}{2}) = \frac{16}{27} \omega \\ & \quad \text{所以 } \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^{n}(n^{2}-n+1)}{2^{n}} = \frac{1}{4} s(-\frac{1}{2}) + \frac{2}{3} = \frac{22}{27} \omega. \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答：设}f(x)&=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{(n+1)(n+2)}x^{n-2}\omega\\ f'(x)&=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{(n+1)}x^{n-1},\ f^*(x)=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}x^n=\frac{x}{1-x}\ (\left|x<1\right)\omega\\ \text{积分}\quad f'(x)&=-x-\ln(1-x)\ ,\ \text{再积分}f(x)=-\frac{1}{2}x^2+x+(1-x)\ln(1-x),\\ \text{所以}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{4(n+1)(n+2)^2}&=f(\frac{1}{2})=\frac{3}{8}-\frac{1}{2}\ln 2.\omega\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答：级数}\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\frac{3^{n}}{n\ln(n+1)}x^{n},\ \text{有}\ R_{1}&=\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}\left|\frac{a_{n}}{a_{n+1}}\right|=\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}\frac{\frac{n\ln(n+1)}{3^{n-1}}}{\frac{(n+1)\ln(n+2)}{}}=\frac{1}{3};\ \omega\\ \text{级数}\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\frac{2^{n}}{n^{2}}x^{n},\ \text{有}\ R_{2}&=\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}\left|\frac{b_{n}}{b_{n+1}}\right|=\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}\frac{\frac{2^{n}}{n^{2}}}{\frac{2^{n+1}}{(n+1)^{2}}}=\frac{1}{2},\ \text{取}\ R=\min(R_{1},R_{2})=\frac{1}{3},\ \omega\\ \text{当}\ x&=-\frac{1}{3}\text{时，级数为}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\left(\frac{(-1)^{n}}{n\ln(n+1)}+\frac{1}{n^{2}}(-\frac{2}{3})^{n}\right),\ \text{收敛；当}\ x=\frac{1}{3}\text{时，级数} \\ &\text{为}\omega\\ &\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\left(\frac{1}{n\ln(n+1)}+\frac{1}{n^{2}}(\frac{2}{3})^{n}\right),\ \text{发散，所以收敛域为}\left[-\frac{1}{3},\frac{1}{3}\right),\omega \end{aligned}
